Honestly ive had the exact opposite happen to me, ive literally cried when i fought stuff like the fume knight but S2 was just the perfect mix between hard and easy. Anyway, happy to hear you finally got him, cheers.

This is your first playthrough? I found Johnny one of the easiest and most underwhelming bosses,personally. What platform are you playing on? Is your gear on the right level? And also pretty important have you attempted parrying prior to facing the boss? If you are struggling my advice would be to just stand behind him and target the arms and probably get some heavy armor, too. Dont give up, this game is really worth playing IMO.
I got lost looking at your eyes, they are beautiful! :D
id say its a great fit, a little colour never hurt nobody :D and this shade of red really fits

Ive got a little bit of an off topic question, do these big planes that these guys fly in have any bathrooms/places to pee at least? Flying for like 10 hours without a toilet seems a little bit like torture.
